help.srcradar.usage:
Usage:
  ./srcradar <module> <script> [args...]
  ./srcradar --list
  ./srcradar -h|--help

Examples:
  ./srcradar manage add_business -n <business>
  ./srcradar pdtm scan -b <business>
  ./srcradar db init_db
  ./srcradar daily daily_monitor
  ./srcradar ymicp icp_mapp_query -b <business>

Module resolution order: modules/private > modules/main > modules/public
  (internal modules override public / default-installed modules)
Script resolution order: <script>.sh > <script>.py
  (executable bit required for .sh, optional for .py)
